newsitem.title: USA: Fed changes rules on revenues from underwriting.
newsitem.headline: Fed changes rules on revenues from underwriting.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said on Wednesday it was changing the way in which subsidiaries of bank holding companies calculate revenues from underwriting and dealing in certain securities.
Current rules specify that the revenue a bank holding company derives from underwriting and dealing cannot exceed 10 percent of the holding company's total revenue.

The Fed said it was amending the rule, effective Nov 12, so that interest earned on debt securities a member bank holds for its own account would not be treated as revenue from securities underwriting and dealing.
